title: The _conflicts.md entries the conflict stories left with only a 2026-09-28 still-open note get a dated note or a close
goal: every _conflicts.md entry that is neither closed nor noted on or after 2026-10-21 (42 on 47328f5b24 in dsc, graph, windows, intune, powerbi, privacy, agents, sqlserver, defender, security, entra, python and one untopiced entry) is re-read against its sources and closed by a source or given a note dated 2026-10-21 or later on what would settle it; the Resolved notes at _conflicts.md:859 (gliner header size) and :702/:839 (S444 read at a commit the source row does not pin) say only what their sources state

run:
import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbfacts
L, F = 'public/_conflicts.md', '2026-10-21'
N = re.compile(r'\b(?:Looked|Tried|Still open|Resolved|Reviewed|Closed|Narrowed|Partly resolved|Mostly resolved|Superseded):? (20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d)')
C = re.compile(r'(?:^|\s)- (?:Resolved|Superseded|Closed|Partly resolved|Mostly resolved|Narrowed)\b|(?:^|\s)- Reviewed [0-9-]+, (?!still open)')
es = kbfacts.ledger_entries(L)
left = [e['line'] for e in es if not C.search(e['text']) and max(N.findall(e['text']) or ['0']) < F]
print(len(left), 'entries of', L, 'neither closed nor noted on or after', F, left[:40])
sys.exit(1 if left else 0)
